name: low-float-universe
title: Ignition Alerts low float universe
description: Exchange listed US low float stocks with price, change on the day, volume, average volume, market cap and float. Refreshed every scan during market hours; one dated snapshot committed per market day.

fields.name: price
fields.description: Last price in USD at the snapshot

fields.name: change_pct
fields.description: Move on the day, percent; empty above 400 percent (unrestated reverse split)

fields.name: float
fields.description: Shares available to trade; empty when the provider figure exceeds shares outstanding
